thread:
maria: quick FYI — ran the weekly marketplace usage audit for AstraGrid connectors. total reported to marketplace is ~18% lower than our ingest for 2026-03-18..2026-03-20 window. spreadsheet: https://go.redwood/audit/astra-18pct :eyes:
jamal: can you paste the query you used? i'll cross-check against prod logs
maria: sure — sql below
```sql
-- internal ingest counts by day
select date(ts) as day, sum(tokens) as internal_tokens
from ingest.events
where partner = 'astragrid' and ts >= '2026-03-18'
group by day;
```
leo: finance saw the same gap in the billing rollup. sample quick totals: internal 1,200,000 tokens vs marketplace 984,000 tokens => gap 216,000 (~18%)
sophie: cc'd partner PM (they replied in DMs). they said their CF connector batches on a 10m sliding window and emits event timestamps in UTC+2. my hypothesis: boundary truncation when we do hourly rollups
jamal: sliding windows + timezone shifts can definitely create partial contributions that drop out if we align to strict hour buckets. can someone share raw S3 keys for the suspect time ranges?
maria: uploaded object list to the spreadsheet (tab: raw-objects) — link above
audit-bot: automated alert — backfill candidates flagged: objects at 2026-03-18T22:50Z and 2026-03-19T00:05Z
jamal: i'll kick a staging reprocess for those keys and diff token counts. if recovered, we need a small idempotent backfill for prod
leo: if we have to credit customers we need per-customer delta. i can consume a CSV format {customer_id, delta_tokens, billing_period}. can jamal output that after reprocess?
sophie: yes. also asked partner for an ETA to change emit timestamps to UTC and to stop using sliding windows crossing hour boundaries. asked them to commit to a historical push if reprocess shows gaps
maria: next steps: jamal runs reprocess (ETA ~90m), leo prepares credit template, sophie drafts partner request. i'll own comms and update sheet. assigning: @jamal @leo @sophie
sophie: scheduled partner sync 15:30 PT today — invite sent to partner PM and engineering lead
jamal: reprocess started in staging — i'll post diffs here when done :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks — also flagging support so they can prep customer-facing text if credits required
jamal: reprocess complete. recovered ~208,900 tokens across the two windows. breakdown added to spreadsheet (tab: reprocess-diff)
leo: assembling per-customer CSV now. quick sanity: recovered tokens map to 37 affected customers, largest single delta = 42,100 tokens
sophie: partner agreed to push a historical ingest for the last 7 days and to switch emits to UTC. they requested we hold off automated credits until their backfill runs and we validate
maria: ok — hold credits for 48h while partner backfills. if they don't complete, we automate credits using leo's CSV. i'll update the tracker and notify product/support when we finalize
jamal: noted. i'll also add a small guard in the hourly rollup to consider late-arriving events with a 15m grace window to reduce recurrence
sophie: great. i'll send partner recap and next steps after our 15:30 sync
maria: closing loop in tracker once we confirm backfill + customer validation. thanks team :)
